notes.title: Wishlist L.S.D. + Demo coming soon (update on the development) - by S.F.
notes.notes:
Hi user!
I hope you're as glas as I am to know that L.S.D. is gathering a lot of wishlists!
As a solo developer this really excites me and encourages me to work as hard as I can on the creation of my game.
The development of the game is keeping me really busy but I'm happy to finally announce that "L.S.D.: Prologue", the playable demo of the game, is coming soon on Steam!
I hope the prologue will keep up with the expectations and that it will build even more hype for the release of the complete official game.
Also, here's the link to our Discord server in case you want to join: https://discord.gg/WBpSjv3qpd
See ya

-S.F.
